name: Listening_1
short_caption: The robot subtly shifts its weight and tilts its head slightly while listening attentively.
movement_description: The robot starts from a neutral standing position, then subtly shifts its torso and shoulders slightly to its right while raising its right elbow outward slightly. Simultaneously, it tilts its head a tiny bit to the left in a listening pose. The robot holds this posture briefly before smoothly returning its body, arms, and head back to the neutral starting position.
